test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The fraudsters __hoodwinked__ us and took away all our valuables.
solution: The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Deceived.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points __** • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option: • **Hoodwinked**- to deceive or trick someone into believing something that is not true, usually in order to take advantage of them. (आंख में धूल झोंकना, धोखा देना) • Deceived- to make someone believe something that is not true, usually in order to gain an advantage or to trick them. (धोखा देना) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • **Coerced**** **- to force or compel someone to do something against their will. (मजबूर) • Threatened- to express an intention to harm someone or to cause them some kind of loss or damage. (धमकी देना) • Misguided- to be led or influenced by false ideas or beliefs. (बहकाना) • The context of the sentence is that the speaker is saying that the fraudsters tricked or deceived them and took away all their valuables. • Clearly, the word 'Deceived' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Hoodwinked.' • Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 4. 3e:Tf03a,
